name: Main Line Art Center Summer Art Camp
description_short: Weekly art camp in the Main Line Art Center studios in Haverford, themed A Summer of Color in 2026. Palette Pals (ages 5 to 9) rotate through art styles and media with several teaching artists, half or full day; pre-teens (10 to 12) and teens (13 to 16) take half day studios in a single medium and can pair two for a full day. Each week ends with an Art Party.
refund_policy_summary: Withdrawals more than two weeks before a session get a full refund less a $50 fee per transaction; no refunds within two weeks. Switching sessions costs $25 and must be asked two weeks ahead.
special_needs_notes: The center offers reasonable accommodations; families should contact the camp director a month before their session.

sessions.name: Session A (4 days, no camp June 19)
Session C (4 days, no camp July 3)

notes: Prices shown are the non-member rates for a five day week: half day (9:00 to 12:00 or 12:30 to 3:30) $284, teen studios $292, Palette Pals full day $568. Member rates: $257 half day, $265 teen studio, $514 full day. The four day Session A is $228 half day ($207 member) or $456 full day ($414 member). After care 3:30 to 5:00 is $130 a week or $35 a day. Campers bring a snack, and full day campers a lunch.
